author: yungmuck
body: So its been 4 months since my perm ban for "auto clicking" and after the 4 months I'm starting to dread the ban and want to know if its been long enough to where I'm able to come back, ive been trying to wait as patiently as possible with the ban and since ive been such an active player and I have donated back in the day with the commitment ive made within the server if I can get welcomed back? In regards Mucky

title: How long

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body: 6 months is the usual wait time for a ban to start becoming old and we feel people usually learn from the ban in that time.
